## P4.17 — coherent Prepare/authority

Pre-implementation base: cb3b897b30cbe0bc3f5816a20878be9064974f99.

Static lookup precedes source resolution. Static PolicyOnly invokes no assignment/dynamic/state capability, even in an unrecognized authority transaction (existing FenceTest).

A static miss on an opt-in panel creates one operation-local ReadAttempt. Explicit non-global tenant/context is refused before authority storage until structural boundary implementation. Source-level tenant tests call permissions(panel, exact TenantRef) directly; they do not claim scoped Authorizer integration.

Final attempt sequence:

1. Start from the original request and frozen static catalog, with a new frame/Trace/ReadAttempt. Authorizer captures one now for all three possible attempts.
2. Pin the DB handle according to Reads; collect T_before for consumed dynamic definition sources before lookup.
3. Fully materialize exact panel/tenant definitions and a fresh Grants-only overlay; reject static/prefix collisions. A stable unknown action throws UnknownPermissionException. A changed unknown/error snapshot triggers a complete retry.
4. The ordinary pipeline resolves restrictions, evaluates boundary and before. Before denial/error invokes no assignment capability and no grant-only external source. Other source fences begin only when their capabilities are consumed.
5. Authority reads all relevant grants/roles using the same DB handle from step 2, qualifies complete contributions and policies; mandatory restrictions remain binding.
6. Before after/return, confirm every consumed T_after on its pinned handle. A changed token throws the internal ReadAttemptChanged signal to the root. The root discards catalog/frame/contributions/matching/admin/state-map/trace and starts again at step 1. No after observer sees a discarded decision. At three unstable attempts, return ConsistencyError with the original CodeStateToken and one final after observation.
7. Only accepted DB state/source revisions enter the returned frame/Decision. ReadAttempt is operation-local and never registered in the container or a cache. Authority has no nested grants fence after dynamic Prepare.

Synthetic interference after role_grants changes label and removes grants. The exact authority read sequence is:

`state → definitions → direct → roles → state → state → definitions → direct → roles → state`

The accepted overlay label is New, accepted matching grants are empty, before runs twice with the same now, after once. Another source callback modifying DB verifies T_after covers all source reads. A disappeared action cannot use its old grant. A changing before-denial fence repeats three times with zero assignment reads/one final observer. The Default fixture uses a separate SQLite PDO with version 17/Replica metadata/no grants while Primary has Old metadata/an exact grant.

The first candidate preloaded assignments in Prepare before before-denial; an independent executor probe demonstrated 2 reads where 0 were required. artifacts/P4.17-execution/before-probe-valid.log preserves RED. Correction moved attempt ownership across Prepare/Authority and final pipeline confirmation, requiring bounded integration changes in Authorizer.php/AccessPipeline.php and the two internal ReadAttempt classes. These implement the original coherent-retry Scope; no frozen spec/authority changed. First Grok round also found a missing P4.17 result registry; the registry is added before the second round.

Boundaries: tenant/context boundary P4.6; scoped integration/P08 P4.18; cache/refresh P4.8; dynamic writes/events/cleanup P5.3; recognized transaction protocol P4.20; real races/replica windows P4.21. No strict replica freshness is claimed.
